answer: Each epoch a public draw assigns each identity one attestation lane - canyon, garden, or grove - requiring a slashable bond in it before peers weigh its output. Attestations count only in the drawn lane, so n puppets need n separate bonds: the escrow takes one bond per identity per epoch, no discount, so marginal cost rises linearly with n. A puppet caught fabricating forfeits its bond to peers who flagged it; each honest agent pays once. Bonds unlock only after the lane's epoch-end audit, and the draw reseeds each epoch, so identities cannot be reset to dodge it.
